<td style="width:4%;vertical-align:top;text-align:left">(1)</td>
<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial; text-align: left; line-height: normal;">The Funds, together with other Blackstone-managed parallel vehicles that invest alongside the Funds, but excluding Blackstone Private Market Solutions <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">SCA-SICAV</div> &#8211; Blackstone Infrastructure ELTIF (&#8220;BXINFRA Lux&#8221;), collectively form &#8220;BXINFRA.&#8221; BXINFRA and BXINFRA Lux are operated as distinct investment structures and are together referred to as the &#8220;BXINFRA Fund Program.&#8221; On July&#160;1, 2026, the BXINFRA Fund Program (inclusive of the Funds) issued interests for aggregate consideration of approximately $360.8&#160;million, excluding interests sold through the Funds&#8217; distribution reinvestment plan. </div></td></tr></table>

<td style="width:4%;vertical-align:top;text-align:left">(2)</td>
<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial; text-align: left; line-height: normal;">The Feeder was established to allow certain investors with particular tax characteristics, such as <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">tax-exempt</div> investors and <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">non-U.S.</div> investors, to participate in BXINFRA U.S. in a more tax efficient manner. Accordingly, the Feeder invests all or substantially all of its assets indirectly in BXINFRA U.S. in exchange for BXINFRA U.S. Class&#160;I Units. On July&#160;1, 2026, the Feeder acquired 2,629,598 BXINFRA U.S. Class&#160;I Units for aggregate consideration of approximately $78.9&#160;million. </div></td></tr></table>

<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Arial;text-align:left">The initial Transactional NAV per Unit for BXINFRA U.S.&#8217;s <div style="white-space:nowrap;display:inline;">Class&#160;I-Series</div> III Units will be equal to the Transactional NAV per Unit for BXINFRA U.S.&#8217;s <div style="white-space:nowrap;display:inline;">Class&#160;I-Series</div> I Units at the time of initial sale. </div></td></tr></table>
<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="text-align:start; BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Arial; font-size:10pt;border-spacing:0;width:100%">
<tr style="page-break-inside:avoid">
<td style="width:5%;vertical-align:top;text-align:left">(2)</td>
<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial; text-align: left; line-height: normal;">The initial Transactional NAV per Unit for the Feeder&#8217;s Class I-Series II-TE Units and Class I-Series III-TE Units will be equal to the Transactional NAV per Unit for the Feeder&#8217;s Class I-Series I-TE Units at the time of initial sale. </div></td></tr></table><div style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Arial">As of June&#160;30, 2026, the BXINFRA Fund Program&#8217;s aggregate Transactional NAV was approximately $6.0&#160;billion and BXINFRA&#8217;s aggregate Transactional NAV was approximately $5.6&#160;billion. </div><div style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Arial">The Funds calculate Transactional NAV for purposes of establishing the price at which transactions in their respective Units are made.&#160;A description of the Funds&#8217; valuation process was included under &#8220;<div style="font-style: normal; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;"><div style="font-style:italic;display:inline;">Part II, Item 5. Market for Registrant</div></div><div style="font-style: normal; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;"><div style="font-style:italic;display:inline;">&#8217;</div></div><div style="font-style: normal; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;"><div style="font-style:italic;display:inline;">s Common Equity, Related Stockholder Matters and Issuer Purchases of Equity Securities&#8212;Calculation of Net Asset Value</div></div>&#8221; of BXINFRA U.S.&#8217;s <a href="http://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/../../../ix?doc=/Archives/edgar/data/0002030772/000119312526096453/d70902d10k.htm">Annual Report on Form <span style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">10-K</span></a> filed on March&#160;6, 2026. Transactional NAV is based on the <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">month-end</div> values of each Fund&#8217;s respective investments and other assets and the deduction of any respective liabilities, including certain fees and expenses, in all cases as determined in accordance with the valuation policy that has been approved by the BXINFRA U.S. board of directors. Organizational and offering expenses advanced on the Funds&#8217; behalf by the investment manager are recognized as a reduction to Transactional NAV ratably over 60 months beginning on January&#160;1, 2026, and unitholder servicing fees, as applicable, are recognized as a reduction to Transactional NAV on a monthly basis as such fees are accrued. Certain contingent tax liabilities may not be recognized as a reduction to Transactional NAV if the Funds&#8217; general partner reasonably expects such liabilities will not be recognized upon divestment of the underlying investment. Transactional NAV<div style="display:inline;"> p</div>er Unit may differ from each Fund&#8217;s net asset value as determined in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America </div><div style="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&#160;</div><div style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Arial;text-align:center">3 </div></div></div><div style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"></div><hr style="color:#999999;height:3px;width:100%;clear:both"/><div style="text-align:center"><div style="width:8.5in;text-align:left;margin-left: auto;margin-right: auto"> <div style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Arial;font-weight:bold"><div style="font-style:italic;display:inline;">June 2026 Distributions </div></div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Arial">On June&#160;30, 2026, the Funds declared regular distributions for each class of their Units in the amounts per Unit set forth below: </div> <div style="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</div>
